title: Army (one entry of data/facs.json); $defs/core is data/core.json
description: facs.json lists the armies in UI order: k is the value of fac in types.json and the key of core.json. core.json gives, per army code, the ordered unit-key pool the bot and Claude seats build from (autoList walks it with the seeded armies stream). The server's English army names are in bt2_snapshot.json (bt_army_en); i18n_en.json translates nm and d.

nm.description: Thai army name; a key of data/i18n_en.json

d.description: Thai blurb; a key of data/i18n_en.json

additionalProperties.description: unit keys of types.json in pool order; hidden units never appear here
